rules: Same228 parent observations;covariance-only risks replayed1e-12. Dual corrected distance=max(corrected Mahalanobis distance,corrected Euclidean distance). Each subtracts its own known expected noise term:2 for normalized Mahalanobis,2*(1-rho_lag) for Euclidean;0 for both clean-oracle guides. Same h=.4/.8,patch5/search21,selfmax. No learned coefficient or truth-fitted threshold. Exact distortion/noise/cross decomposition retained.
limitations: Intersection of similarities is a heuristic,not a calibrated likelihood/probability. Max of corrected noisy distances can bias rejection upwards;smaller unnormalized weights do not guarantee less distortion or risk after normalization. Oracle stationary covariance/scale;two repeated trials per scene,no independent photo validation.No production changes.
